defect.what: pytest is not a declared dependency; uv run pytest fell through to a Python 3.10 pytest on PATH while the project pins ==3.14.*
defect.why_invisible: environment.json records platform.python_version() from a SIBLING process launched with uv run python, which is genuinely 3.14.6
defect.consequence: every test result recorded before 2026-09-21 was measured on Python 3.10
defect.why_it_mattered: Python 3.12 replaced the single STRING token for an f-string with an FSTRING_START/MIDDLE/END group; the glued-concatenation guard walked STRING tokens and was therefore INERT for f-strings on the pinned interpreter while reporting as passing

how_it_surfaced: a new assertion passed under one runner and failed under the other; the disagreement was the finding
corrections: FSTRING_* token groups rejoined into one literal, with depth counting for nesting
static_edges replaces ast.literal_eval, which raises on an f-string
the detector now has a test that it detects, with four cases
tests/test_interpreter_pin.py asserts the running interpreter satisfies requires-python

first_honest_full_suite.runner: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests

correction_of_record: any test count in a package sealed before 2026-09-21 was measured on Python 3.10, whatever the python_version field beside it says
scientific_effect: NONE. No scientific verdict in this project rests on a test count. No verdict is withdrawn.
rule_adopted: a recorded interpreter version must be measured by the process that ran the work, not by a sibling process; a runner that is not a declared dependency is not a pinned runner
